title: Mixed Event — Stream With Friends♡ Wedding Live!

meta.Outline: Minori has started doing solo walking-tour streams as part of MORE MORE JUMP!'s activities. One day, she follows a viewer's recommendation to check out the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Line: Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, I'm back with you again today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, Minori Hanasato, will be visiting all the places everyone's been talking about for my solo stream! Which I've titled...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“Walking with Minori!”
Here we go♪ Can I have a round of applause♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Finally!>
<Episode three already, huh?>
<I really liked the plushie cafe you visited last time.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for all the comments, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I started doing these as a way to make up for us not doing as many streams, since we've been getting more offers for TV and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Can't wait to see where you go today!>
<Streams are great for these direct interactions.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Everyone seems to be enjoying things, so I'm really glad that I decided to start doing these...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, it's time to reveal where I'll be going!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Today, I'll be visiting...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Where's she gonna go?>
<I'm so excited...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Get this...!
The Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<The Phoenix Bridal Fair?!>
<That wedding convention?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's right!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not only do they have lots of different wedding dresses on display, you can also see various kinds of ceremonies that you wouldn't normally!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I've never been, so I wanna see what they have!>
<I'm looking forward to seeing what a big wedding convention is like.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad that a lot of you are excited!
I've been meaning to go ever since I received this request!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also received special permission to do my stream there, so we gotta go check it out!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm a little nervous since I've never done a stream on-site at a big event like this before...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But I'm gonna do my best to make sure everyone has lots of fun!)
Outside the Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Let's see...
That sign said the entrance for part-time staff is somewhere around here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, there we go.
That door must be it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't help but feel nervous...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I asked Emu for some work leads to save up for that Blu-ray set I've been after...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this job doesn't just involve being a part of their show. The description also said that I'll have to help show the guests where everything is...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(This isn't like our shows...
On top of me not knowing anyone here, I'm not sure how I feel about talking to the guests.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope everything goes okay today...)
<Nene♪ Are you there?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? L-Luka?
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You said that you'd be working during your day off when you visited SEKAI a little while back, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I was wondering if you were feeling nervous, since I noticed you sighing quite a lot. So, I came to see how you were doing♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<There's no need to thank me.
Still, you do seem nervous. Your shoulders are so stiff, you look like a robot...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I am a little nervous since I don't know anybody here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hmm... Then, I know...♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Just picture everyone in their underwear while saying, “Fear, fear, disappear.”♪ That should help you feel much more relaxed, no?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah... Luka, I think you're mixing up a few different things there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Am I? You think so?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You say, “Pain, pain, go away,” when you get hurt, and you pretend a crowd is in their underwear when you're feeling nervous.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Wow♪
You're so knowledgeable, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, I am starting to feel a little better.
So, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm glad that I could help♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Anyway, can you tell me what exactly your job today involves?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'll be doing a couple things today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Half of my job involves being a member of this fair's cast. I'll be playing the lead for the show that the Phoenix Bridal Fair is doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, you're playing the lead?
That's so wonderful.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
It's only about thirty minutes long, so it's pretty short for a show. But I want to make the most of this experience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And the other half of my job involves showing the guests around and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Showing the guests around?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, just until the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It involves some types of wedding ceremonies you don't normally get to see, so I'm kinda excited.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Ceremonies you don't normally get to see...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, like a wedding in the clouds?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Miku and I were just talking the other day about how it'd be fun to do a show up in the clouds♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I mean, they're just so white, beautiful and fluffy... Not only would it be the perfect place for a wedding, I'm sure I'd sleep like a baby...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: U-Unfortunately, you can't actually stand on top of clouds... But that still does sound like fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Wouldn't it be♪
Please let me know if you hear about any weddings like that, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure I ever will...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, it's almost time for the staff to meet!
We'll talk again soon, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Okay! Good luck, Nene♪
I'll be rooting for you♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks!
Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Good morning!
My name is Kusanagi. I'm here as a part-timer today...

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Ah, Ms. Kusanagi, there you are!
Thank you for joining us today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, thank you for having me!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: The other cast members have told me all about you. They say you've made quite the name for yourself singing at PXL! I'm looking forward to seeing your performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Hehe. There's no need to feel so anxious.
You're more of a pro when it comes to doing shows, and helping the guests is really very easy.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: It really just involves standing in front of the big map by the entrance and letting them know what's on each floor. The others on the staff will jump in to help if they have any questions, so no worries there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Understood!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
I should be able to handle that.)

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Anyway, we'll need you to change into this right away.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You want me to wear this...?!
Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, this place is huge! And everything's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Here we are, you guys!
I've arrived at the venue for the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's way bigger than I imagined!>
<What's that thing in the back? An aquarium?>
<Tell us more!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I can tell you're all really excited♪ So, lemme start reporting on what's around me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... Based on the pamphlet they were giving out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is the second Phoenix Bridal Fair, and the theme of this convention is “A Smile-Filled Wedding Designed Just For You!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It looks like the dress exhibit, fitting area and the chapel next door for mock weddings are all back from the first time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But the exhibit's supposed to be even more amazing this time around! And you can experience ceremonies that you wouldn't see normally!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Are they that unusual?>
<Can you tell us more?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So... They have ceremonies for trains, aquariums and the great outdoors...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Like on a real train?!>
<An aquarium wedding sounds really fun!>
<Oh, imagine getting married while surrounded by nature!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Apparently, there's also a wedding show scheduled for later. And it finishes by saying, “We hope you enjoy this supercharged iteration of the Phoenix Bridal Fair!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I didn't know about this wedding show...!
That sounds like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, everyone, what should we check out first?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<The train wedding!>
<The fitting area!>
<You should go wherever you like, Minori.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no! So many different suggestions...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm... Where to go first...?
They all sound really fun, but...
E-Excuse me... Are you in need of assistance?
If you'd like, I can tell you more about what's available on each floor...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that'd be great!
Then... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: N-Nene...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hanasato...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Nene
rows.Line: Why are you...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What are you doing here, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-It's a long story...!
Anyway, Hanasato, you have your phone on a selfie stick. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Are you friends with the staff, Minori?>
<Oh, can we see your friend more?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No...!
Nene's in frame!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Wh-What do I do?! I can't show her without asking for her permission first. Also, even with the camera pointed back at me now, us just talking would reveal too much information about her...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (As much as I don't wanna do this to everyone who's watching right now...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm really sorry, you guys, but I have to pause here for a second, for my friend's sake!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I had a feeling.>
<Come back soon!>
<Have fun.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ph-Phew... That was close...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thanks, Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, I'm sorry for interrupting your stream like that. I really had no idea it was you... Anyway, I'll let you get back to what you were doing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, that's okay!
My viewers said they'd wait for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: More importantly, what are you doing here? And that dress you're wearing...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, uhh... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're working as a part-timer!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but no one told me that I'd be wearing this dress until I got here today. That was a pretty big surprise...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Still, it looks amazing on you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I mean, it's so you!
Plus, your hair and makeup are spot-on!
You really look like you're about to get married today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...
I'm still a little embarrassed, but I appreciate the compliment...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does this mean you're gonna be wearing that dress all day while helping the guests?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I will be helping the guests...
But my job today mostly centers around the show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I saw that in the pamphlet!
You guys are doing a wedding show, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right.
“The Happy Wedding Show” will be taking place later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And helping the guests while wearing this dress is supposed to double as an advertisement for that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know you might not be able to since you're doing a stream, but I hope you'll be free later to come and see it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course!
I should be done streaming by then, so I'll be there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, I shouldn't keep you from your fans. Feel free to resume your stream and...
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Woman's Voice
rows.Line:
Ms. Kusanagi, do you have a minute?
Oh, hold on.

rows.Speaker: Female Staff Member
rows.Line:
By any chance...
Are you Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
Y-Yes, I'm Minori Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Female Staff Member
rows.Line:
I knew it!
I'd heard about your stream, but I still wasn't expecting to see you here in person...!

rows.Speaker: Female Staff Member
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
My name is Nozaki. I'm in charge of marketing for this event.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: My daughter's actually a huge MORE MORE JUMP! fan, and we watch your streams together often. I couldn't help but get a little giddy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, is that true?!
Th-That's so wonderful to hear!

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: You two seemed to be having a rather friendly chat just now, Ms. Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, um... We're acquaintances.
We go to different schools, but we've practiced singing together before...

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
Ah, so you are friends.
You two do seem to be around the same age.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: Our target demographic also included girls in your age group, Ms. Hanasato, so I'm glad you decided to come. Again, I heard that you'd be doing a stream here today...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, that's right! My streams involve visiting places my viewers want to go and talking about what I see. I was actually just about to start taking a look around.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
Then, I hope you enjoy everything!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I plan on seeing as much as I can since my viewers sounded very excited about this convention!

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: Your viewers...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...?
Is something the matter, Ms. Nozaki?

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
...
Ms. Hanasato? If possible...

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: I'd like to make an official offer regarding your stream today. Would you be willing to accept?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
I know this is very sudden.
Normally, I'd contact your manager about this and go through all the necessary steps with them...

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: But us running into each other like this has to be more than a simple coincidence. So, if it's possible, would you be able to accept my offer? There's just so much we want to tell your viewers...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Tell them...?

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: Yes, about just how much fun weddings are.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: These days, you hear people saying weddings cost too much, or that they're too much bother.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: But if someone your age used her platform to show just how much fun weddings really are and how low-stress they can be, I feel that you'd be able to reach a wide audience...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
But again, I know this is very sudden...
If you don't feel comfortable accepting, then I'll understand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please give me a minute to discuss with our group's manager!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh, but...
I still plan on showing as many things as I can during my stream either way, so there's no need for you to worry there!

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, really!
I think the message you're trying to send is really nice, and I want to make the most of all the opportunities I can get as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(That's incredible...
I wouldn't be able to make a quick decision like that if I were put in her situation.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her experience as a professional idol really comes through.)

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Ms. Hanasato...!
I'd also like to discuss this with your manager.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, actually... I've already started streaming, and I'm keeping everyone waiting right now... Would it be okay for me to resume in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Please feel free to resume whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
Oh, actually...
Would you like a member of the staff to join you? That should make covering everything much easier.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
I know.
Would you mind lending her a hand, Ms. Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
Yes, since you two seem to be friends.
I figured that her stream would go much smoother with you as her guide...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, you're probably right... But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Doesn't this mean I have to show my face in front of the camera...? While wearing this dress, of all things...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But Hanasato's viewers should be focused on her, so maybe I shouldn't be so worried. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Would you like to help me, Nene?!
Oh, but it's totally okay if you don't feel up to it...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
Those puppy-dog eyes...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I guess this'll be good experience for me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I want to perform all around the world as a pro myself, I need to get comfortable dealing with these sorts of situations.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
You will?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thanks for doing this, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Thanks for having me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is going to be my first stream ever, so I don't know how everything will go... But I promise to do what I can.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No problem!
Let's do our best together!
Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait, everyone!
The stream's back up and running♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<There she is!>
<Welcome back.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for waiting, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Guess what?! I've got some good news!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Good news?>
<Does it have to do with that girl you were talking to just now?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, it actually does!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're not gonna believe this!
Today, we get to have one of the Phoenix Bridal Fair staff as our guide! Let's give Nene Kusanagi a big round of applause!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... H-Hi...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, is this your friend?!>
<She'll be on your stream?!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Umm...
Hello, viewers... My name is Nene Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you for having me on today...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Your dress is so pretty!>
<Welcome aboard!>
<Wait, isn't she in WXS?!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right. She's a member of Wonderlands×Showtime! They put on the night show that went viral a little while back!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She's playing the lead in the wedding show that's taking place in the evening, so make sure to drop by the Phoenix Bridal Fair if you happen to be in the neighborhood!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I wanna see the show!>
<Does this mean you're gonna stream the show?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. They all sound really excited!
Thanks again for doing this, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right. Of course...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, now that we're all set and ready to go, it's time to resume Minori's walk through the Phoenix Bridal Fair...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright, then...
Let's start with the train wedding booth.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, the train wedding...!
That was in the pamphlet! It takes place on a real one, right?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But how do you actually hold the ceremony...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
By renting out a part of a station.
You hold the ceremony aboard a train car or on the tracks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Apparently, the platform signs and line names are all specially designed for the wedding, so it's supposed to be a really memorable experience.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The platform signs...?
Does that mean you can have the train headed for the “Paradise of Love” and stuff?! If so, that would be really memorable...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'm not sure about that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, the wedding taking place on a train means...

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: <The train carrying the bride will be arriving on this platform shortly. Please stand behind the yellow line for your own safety.>
se_event_wedding_2024_001
se_event_wedding_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all for coming today!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope you'll all give me a warm welcome when I arrive at the station of Eternal Happiness.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Harukaaa...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?!
H-Hanasato?! Is something wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-The thought of Haruka being aboard that train almost made my heart explode...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Oh, okay...
You really surprised me there.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That's our Minori for you.>
<Always on the Haruka hype train.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone watching seems totally fine with this. I guess this is how she always is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry, everyone. I really can't help myself...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But how amazing would it be to have the station announce that the bride is arriving on the platform?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone would toss flower petals into the air as she steps out of the train.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And she'd step back onto the train after its destination changes to the “Future”! Wouldn't that be so romantic?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your imagination's very specific...

rows.Speaker: Booth Attendant
rows.Line:
I see...
That certainly would be fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Booth Attendant
rows.Line:
Oh, pardon me.
I'm in charge of this booth, and I gave what you just said a little thought...

rows.Speaker: Booth Attendant
rows.Line: The train displays and announcements can be changed easily enough, so your idea may be worth trying.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
I'm glad to hear that what I said helped!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Her delusion ended up contributing...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Nice work!>
<Way to go, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks for the praise.
But I have Haruka to thank for this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure how much credit Kiritani deserves...

rows.Speaker: Nene

Three, two, one... Poof!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “I-I'm in a dress now...!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “That's right! You made your wish, and your wish took form!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “My wish took form?”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line:
“This dress is gorgeous...
I'd love to be wearing this when we get married.”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Did she just get changed?!
How?! In that instant?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That was fast, but I'm sure there's some clever trick involved...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Still, that was incredible!
It really felt like magic.

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Hehe. All that's left is for you to take that big step! Are you ready?”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Of course!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “Then, let's go to where your beloved is!”

rows.Speaker: Live House Angel
rows.Line: “And tell him that you want to have a wedding!”

rows.Speaker: Woman
rows.Line: “Okay!”
Outside the chapel

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's it for today's episode of Walking with Minori brought to you from the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, this one went on for so long that it felt like a special feature...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, what did you guys think?
Did you all have fun?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was way too much fun! Time really flew by!>
<I really enjoyed getting to learn more about you and your friends, Minori!>
<I wish I could've gone today! I'm definitely going tomorrow!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
Looks like they enjoyed everything.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I really enjoyed your segment, Nene!>
<You should come visit again soon.>
<Awesome show, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks...
I'm a little embarrassed, but also really happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Nene, that reminds me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much again for helping me when I forgot my line during that scene!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, I know what it feels like to draw a blank at a crucial moment...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, all too well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Hanasato, I was really impressed by the way you were able to go along with my ad-libbing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I should take this opportunity to also thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your singing and dancing really made everyone smile in the end.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Next time, I'd like for you to see one of our shows as a member of the audience. We promise to make it an unforgettable experience.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, we'll have to end things here!
Make sure to tune in next time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just gotta make sure I hit the “End Stream” button and...
Okay, that's a wrap!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness we made it through...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks again for everything you did today, Nene!
Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice work today, you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm really sorry about the show!
After I promised to see it with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
I need to apologize. Please don't blame Hanasato for what happened...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
There's no need to apologize.
We figured that she had a good reason.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Between how fun your performance was, Hanasato, and you magically changing into that dress, Kusanagi, everyone in the audience really seemed to enjoy themselves.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
This is sorta unrelated, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I took a video of the show since it was okay for us to record.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I was wondering if you could use it for one of your MMJ streams.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line: <So, let me take this opportunity to show you an example of a fun live house wedding!>

rows.Speaker: Minori's Voice
rows.Line:
<Everyone!
It's time to start the Happy Wedding Concert!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, you took such an amazing video!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's so steady, and the sound's crystal clear. I'm sure Hanasato will have an easy time commentating.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
You can even see everyone's faces really clearly, so it felt like a shame for me to just hog it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, it's not every day that we get to see you sing and act on stage like this. I'm sure it'll be fun for all of you to discuss it as a group.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, Nene!
Would it be okay for us to use this video for one of our streams?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd have to ask Ms. Nozaki, but I'm pretty sure that there won't be any problems.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If anything, she'll probably want you to use it. Lemme give her a quick call.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank goodness I was able to get permission. I need to tell Hanasato right away...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Nice work today, Nene♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I saw everything in secret.
I was so glad to see both your show and stream go as well as they did♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks... Me too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, I really got to experience a lot today.
Working part-time here, doing that stream, holding a talk segment...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Then, this day must've filled you with so much joy. Like it was your own wedding day♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You might be right.
It was a pretty packed day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <See what I mean?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Still, I like the idea of being the bride on her wedding day...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I might just ask the others if we can do a show about a wedding after I get back.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we should do a show about one in SEKAI sometime.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait...
Huh? Where are Mochizuki and the others?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, they said they had plans afterwards, so they had to leave! But they asked me to thank you for everything that happened today, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay.
Oh, Hanasato, I got permission from Ms. Nozaki. You and your group can use that video for a stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thank you so much! I promise to make good use of it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we both go get changed and head home?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, umm... Together?
I probably have to go help clean up and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's okay! I can wait!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, uhh, but I don't wanna cause you any trouble!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, you won't be...
If anything, I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh... I'm really glad you asked...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You are?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: While we're at it, we should get something to eat! There's a really yummy-looking place just over there!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, that'd be nice.
I've been working since this morning, so I could probably eat a horse right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
Then, let's hurry and get changed!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nooo...!
Th-The hem of this dress is so long!
I keep stepping on it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, Hanasato.
Be careful not to trip over it, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay!
